label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a single-bit axe: flared crescent blade, poll lug, collar, ridged grip and ball pommel all break the outline; top view is a thin blade line plus gold cap, which is the expected view for a flat axe head.
evidence.V2: Clear big/medium/small: big blade and haft, medium gold collar, lower ring and pommel plus the steel poll, small ink grip wraps and top cap.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: oversized flared blade with a curved edge on a chunky collar, haft about 2x the head height, with a fat pommel; the blade tapers in thickness from neck to edge (top view). A15 Y error 0.0, head and collar alignment offsets 0.0, both seats seated with no gap, so no correctness cap.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on collar lips, ring, cap and pommel, and a bevelled cutting-edge strip that catches a clean highlight in close_edge_studio; nothing razor-sharp or blobby.
evidence.V5: Minor: where the neck chamfers converge into the blade face there is a pinched triangular facet (dark wedge in close_collar_studio and flat, crease on the neck in the front view). Grip, haft and blade faces are otherwise clean, with no z-fighting at the collar (cross-shell overlaps are intentional).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel-grey blade, gold accents, one hue (teal) for the haft with ink-dark wraps; the colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue and keep the gold and steel.
evidence.V7: 1916 tris against a weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000), so at or under target.
evidence.V8: Indistinguishable from the kit: one white vertex-colour material, kit gold, ink and steel plus one hue, small uniform chamfers, smooth shading; it matches the Axe_05 anchor's construction language.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Tool Handle, origin at the grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pinched triangular facet / crease where the neck chamfers converge into the blade face, just right of the collar (close_collar_studio, close_collar_flat, front view).
top_fixes: Rework the neck-to-blade transition so the chamfers on the neck run out evenly into the blade bevel, with no converging wedge facet (add a support loop or blend the chamfer width), so V5 can reach clean.
Optional: give the blade face a slight hollow or a fuller line near the neck to push the head's medium-level detail without adding many tris (budget headroom about 580 tris).
Optional: lengthen the cutting edge's lower beard tip a little so the outline reads better from the top and side views.
